title: Mt Holland lithium expansion project final investment decision
excerpt: SQM and Wesfarmers approved an expansion intended to increase Mt Holland nameplate spodumene concentrate production from about 380,000 to 760,000 tonnes per year at 5.5% Li2O on a 100% basis.
summary: Primary exchange announcement dated 2026-07-22. The expansion includes mine work, a second concentrator, and integrated ore sorting intended to lower unit costs and recover stockpiled material. Construction is expected to begin in the second half of 2027, with first expanded output in the first half of 2030. SQM's share of nominal capital expenditure is estimated at USD 450-500 million. The decision adds long-dated capacity and cost optionality but also execution, approval, commodity-cycle, and capital-allocation risk; it provides no updated normalized ADS valuation.
